Name: Carmi, Son of Zabdi
Summary: Carmi, son of Zabdi, was the father of Achan, whose taking of devoted plunder at Jericho cost Israel the battle of Ai.
KeyStory: Carmi's son Achan confessed to hiding a garment, silver, and gold, and the whole household paid for the sin.
RelatedPeople: Zabdi, Father of Carmi; Achan; Joshua
LifeLesson: A father's name can be remembered through a son's worst day — and still be worth redeeming.
